incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Spike in 500s for customer-redwood-inc — service=redwood-inference route=/v1/chat/generate errors=502->504 (90s window) pagerduty=PD-78921
ashok: oncall here, looking now. Any immediate mitigation?
marta: seeing a flood of `incompatible_schema` in the logs, looks like requests intended for chat are being routed to an embeddings variant. 1st guess: fallback policy selected wrong variant.
kevin: copying logs — here's a sample: 
```
2026-03-14T21:18:41Z ERROR router: route_id=chat-prod req_id=abc123 target_variant=embed-quant-v2 reason=fallback_policy:capability_mismatch response=500 payload_error=unsupported_message_type
```
lia_oncall: confirmed. The pinned model for this tenant was recently updated by config push 2026-03-14T20:05 (pin: model-chat-3b@v42). The routing policy `smart-fallback:preferred=low-cost,capability` seems to pick any "compatible" variant when capacity low.
ashok: that matches. Root cause hypothesis: pinned model version mismatch — the control plane thinks the pinned asset is a gen/instruct-capable artifact, but the variant registry has it classified as an embedding-only artifact (or vice-versa). When model is unavailable, policy picks the embedding variant which can't process chat schema -> 500s.
marta: customer impact: 8% of tenant requests failing, latency spikes for rest. Ticket: INC-6379 opened, PD-78921 escalated to P1.
kevin: quick mitigation options: 1) disable smart-fallback for affected tenant 2) force route to last-known-compatible variant 3) pin to previous stable model version 4) enable circuit-breaker to failover to hosted fallback that rejects incompatible types with 4xx instead of 500.
lia_oncall: I'm going to disable smart-fallback for the tenant now and pin to `model-chat-3b@v41` (previous). Doing via admin console.
incident-bot: Action log: disable_fallback tenant=customer-redwood-inc by=lia_oncall at=2026-03-14T21:20:07Z
lia_oncall: patched pin -> `model-chat-3b@v41`. Monitoring metrics.
marta: routing errors dropping. 500s down from 22/s to 1/s in last 60s. :thumbsup:
ashok: leaving a follow-up: we need a short-term guard in routing: verify variant capability matches request type before applying fallback. Also add telemetry for "policy-induced-incompatibility".
kevin: logging a quick config snippet that will help prevent this class of failure: 
```
routing.policies.smart_fallback {
  check_compatibility = true  # ensure target.variant.capabilities contains request.type
  max_region_hops = 2        # prevent loops across regions
  deny_on_incompat = true    # return 4xx instead of silently forwarding
}
```
marta: we should also add a safety check during pin/change flows: when a pin is applied, validate the variant kind (chat/instruct/embed/embed-gen) and block pins that map to incompatible kinds for routes that declare schema.
lia_oncall: agreed, filing FR: FR-1721 to add validation + UI warning.
kevin: handoff: I'm taking 2hr watch to verify no regressions, will escalate to platform-team if errors > 3% in next 30m. @marta if you want to take overnight, ping me.
marta: I'll take follow-up during morning shift, leaving notes. Key items: 1) add pre-pin validation 2) change smart-fallback default to `deny_on_incompat=true` for tenants with schema routes 3) add alert rule for fallback-induced-500s.
sre-bot: note: created follow-up issue PLATFORM-1584 (routing compatibility checks) linked to INC-6379.
incident-bot: Incident severity updated -> P1 by lia_oncall at 2026-03-14T21:28:47Z.
kevin: customer comms: requesting SLA/CS to draft a status update: brief root cause + mitigation + ETA for fix (24-48h).
marta: drafting. Initial impact window ~20:05-21:25 UTC, affected requests ~8-10% for tenant, root cause: policy-induced fallback to embedding-only variant due to pinned version/variant mismatch.
lia_oncall: final note — watch for any region fallback loops. We saw a small loop earlier where region routing tried us-east -> eu-west -> us-east because of capacity preference; max_region_hops set to 2 helped.
nashok: thanks team. I'll update incident channel and close once PLATFORM-1584 has a PR and the pinned-version sanity checks are live. :eyes:
